subject: Fitting multivariate Poisson lognormal model in rstanarm

messages.author: d6a22ac7ce11aa1b
messages.subject: Fitting multivariate Poisson lognormal model in rstanarm
parts:
Hi All,

I am looking forward to extend my univariate model (the response variable has one level only) to multivariate model (the response variable has more than one category). So far I have been using the rstanarm while working with the univariate model (glmer function).

Is it possible to work with the same glmer function to create multivariate model? I will appreciate your help.

Thank you.

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Fitting multivariate Poisson lognormal model in rstanarm
parts:
On Monday, March 13, 2017 at 10:06:50 AM UTC-4, malai...@gmail.com wrote:
Is it possible to work with the same glmer function to create multivariate model? I will appreciate your help.

The stan_glmer() function only deals with univariate outcomes. I think the brms package does not do multivariate Poisson yet, but it might get you most of the way there if you just do stan_code() and stan_data() on a multivariate Gaussian model and then edit the Stan code yourself to call with stan().

Ben
